admin.title: Administration
admin.heading: ADMINISTRATION
admin.center_intro: Manage user accounts, roles, and access to DoomVault.
admin.manage_users_description: Review operator access, roles, credentials, and account state.
admin.security_description: Configure organization password and session protection.
admin.overview_note: Deleted accounts are excluded from these totals. Pending accounts need a valid temporary credential before their first sign-in.
admin.user_intro: Review non-deleted accounts and manage their access.
admin.delete_account_warning: Deletion removes access and preserves historical records. This account cannot be restored.
admin.user_security_note: Blocking, role changes, and password resets revoke existing sessions. Unblocking preserves credential validity; an account without usable credentials still needs provisioning.
admin.create_intro: New accounts await provisioning. Generate a temporary credential now, or provision the account later from the user list.
admin.temporary_note: Temporary credentials are valid for 12 hours and are displayed once. The user must choose a new permanent password at first sign-in.
admin.admin_protected: The permanent ADMIN identity and role are protected.
admin.self_role_protected: You cannot remove your own administrative role.
admin.sensitive_change_note: Security-sensitive changes revoke existing sessions. Account status and password actions are available on the user list.
admin.credential_intro: A new temporary credential has been issued for {username}.
admin.credential_delivery: This credential is displayed once. Deliver it securely to the account owner before leaving this page. Do not refresh this page to retrieve it again.
admin.credential_effect: The user must set a new permanent password at sign-in. Existing sessions and previous temporary credentials have been invalidated. A blocked account remains blocked.
admin.security_intro: Configure organization password and session policies.
admin.forbidden_policy_intro: Reject future permanent passwords that contain an organization-specific dictionary entry.
admin.forbidden_policy_help: Disabling this check does not disable minimum length or password history protection.
admin.minimum_length_intro: Applies to future permanent password setup and changes. Existing passwords are not invalidated.
admin.minimum_length_help: Variant 10 requires at least {minimum} characters. Supported maximum: {maximum}.
admin.password_validity_intro: Set periodic validity for permanent passwords. Users with expired passwords can only replace them or sign out.
admin.password_validity_help: Zero disables periodic expiration and is the recommended default. Supported maximum: {maximum} days.
admin.session_security_intro: End server-side sessions after a period without authenticated activity.
admin.session_timeout_help: Existing live sessions use the new policy on their next server-side validation. Expired and revoked sessions remain unusable.
admin.temporary_credentials_help: {hours} hours maximum validity. This safety limit is read-only. Temporary credentials still require a permanent password at first sign-in.
admin.login_protection_intro: Limit failed authentication attempts. Account and IP cooldowns last a fixed {minutes} minutes.
admin.account_login_limit_intro: Temporarily lock a submitted account identity after repeated failures within 15 minutes.
admin.account_login_limit_help: Whole number from {minimum} to {maximum}. The lockout duration is fixed at {minutes} minutes.
admin.ip_login_limit_intro: Limit failures across different usernames from the same direct source address.
admin.ip_login_limit_help: Whole number from {minimum} to {maximum}. The cooldown is fixed at {minutes} minutes.
admin.dictionary_intro: Manage organization-specific terms rejected in future permanent passwords while the policy is enabled.
admin.word_help: Entries are trimmed and matched case-insensitively. Unicode-equivalent and accented/unaccented Polish forms are treated consistently.
admin.dictionary_count: {count} forbidden entry/entries. Changes apply to subsequent password validation.
admin.delete_word_warning: This removes the term from future password checks.
admin.dictionary_empty: The dictionary is empty. Add an entry above.
